Subject: Re: Redwood trial details

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the walkthrough earlier — the demo clarified a lot. Internal execs are excited but have one ask before we commit to the pilot: could Redwood extend the trial window by an extra month and add additional free inference credits to cover our expected spike during image-to-text ingestion testing?

Concretely:
- +30 days on the 60-day pilot (total 90 days)
- $10k worth of inference credits up-front to cover the first two weeks of heavy ingestion

If there’s a commercial offset (e.g., a preferred committed rate for a 12-month purchase after pilot) that’s acceptable, our procurement team may greenlight faster.

Appreciate if you can route this to the right person for approval.

Best,

Cc:

Subject: Fwd: ZenOptic trial details — ask for combined trial extension + credits + commit concession

Marissa / Ben,

Forwarding Sasha's ask. Quick summary and recommendation:
- Customer: ZenOptic Imaging (healthcare imaging startup)
- Ask: Extend pilot by 30 days (60 -> 90) + $10k in free inference credits upfront
- Trade: Customer eager to sign a 12-month committed uplift after pilot; they've signaled willingness to take a committed SKU if we provide a promotional unit-credit + discounted committed rate (they mentioned procurement would move faster)

My proposed package (sales-approved ask):
1) Trial extension: 30 days (total 90 days)
2) Free credits: $10,000 applied as platform credits usable during pilot (one-off)
3) Post-pilot incentive: 12-month committed contract at 20% off list for inference units if signed within 30 days after pilot ends

Why we should approve:
- High-value vertical (medical imaging); strong reference potential and likely expansion (device OEM pipeline)
- Pilot shows modeled token volume that blows past the standard credit allocation — without the extra credits they’ll hit throttles and poor UX
- A 12-mo commit with 20% comp provides predictable ARR and offsets the upfront credits in 6 months at projected usage

Requested approvals: exec signoff for the combined exception (credits + extension) and confirmation that CS/Finance can track redemption and clawback if commit isn’t executed.

Related artifacts attached: proposed-terms-zenoptic.pdf and pilot summary.

If you want a conservative alternative: reduce free credits to $6k and keep the 20% commit concession.

Thanks — can you both weigh in? Need a yes/no by EOD Tuesday to keep momentum.

— Grace
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Grace.OConnor@redwood.com
(415) 555-0193

From: ben_carter@redwood.com

Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: ZenOptic trial details — ask for combined trial extension + credits + commit concession

Grace / Marissa —

I support approving a combined exception, with a couple of guardrails:
- Approve exactly: $8,000 in platform credits (not $10k) + 30-day extension.
- Approve the 20% off for a 12-month committed plan, but require a signed LOI or simple purchase order within 45 days after pilot ends to avoid clawback complications.
- Finance will require a short recons clause in the SOW: if they don’t convert to the committed purchase within the window, remaining unused credits are forfeited and we reserve the right to charge list rates retroactively for any overage during pilot beyond the credit amount.

Reasoning: $8k gets them through the ingestion spike and reduces our cash-equivalent exposure; 20% on a 12-mo commit is within the leadership playbook for strategic enterprise pilots.

Marissa, please add legal/finance to scope the SOW language and confirm tracking in Console.

Ben
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
